metaTitle: Party Dessert Cups for Hamilton & GTA Events
metaDescription: Party dessert cups for weddings, showers, birthdays, graduations and office events in Hamilton and the GTA: sizes, packs, colour themes and timing.
h1: Party dessert cups for every kind of event
intro: Showers, weddings, birthdays, office afternoons, big family celebrations: every gathering has a dessert moment. Make it a table of hand-layered cups: cups so good people stop talking when they hit the spoon. We've been making them by hand in Hamilton, Ontario since 2024, with free pickup in Hamilton and delivery on Saturdays. Pick your event below, or read on for the planning basics every order shares.

sections.heading: Start with your event
sections.body:
Each page below covers what's specific to that kind of day. Sizes, packs, notice, delivery and pickup are the same for every event, so they're further down this page.

- [Weddings](/events/weddings): planning a dessert table around your wedding colours, what the 96 pack's custom label option and event-day pickup add on the day, and the presentation tray you can add at an extra cost.
- [Baby showers](/events/baby-showers): pink, lilac and sunny-yellow flavours for a shower theme, and how to split a pack between them.
- [Bridal showers](/events/bridal-showers): building the table around a Premium centrepiece flavour, and planning the shower and the wedding together.
- [Birthdays](/events/birthdays): building a mix that works when kids and adults share the same table.
- [Graduations](/events/graduations): picking flavours to echo school colours, and timing your request around a ceremony weekend.
- [Corporate dessert boxes](/events/corporate): ordering for the office, a client meeting or a team celebration when you don't know everyone's tastes or allergies.
- [Cultural and religious celebrations](/events/celebrations): big family gatherings and festival tables, and how a 96 (up to 16 flavours) handles a big spread.

sections.heading: Sizes and packs for an event
sections.body:
Mini Shots (2 oz) are the tasting size and suit a dessert table where guests try a few flavours, while Dessert Cups (5 oz) are a full serving for when the cup is the dessert you hand out. The 96 is the event pack: it brings a custom label option and event-day pickup, and it needs at least 7 days' notice. A presentation tray is available at an extra cost if you ask for one. Packs start at $45 for 24 Classic Mini Shots and $99 for 24 Classic Dessert Cups, before delivery, and every price, perk and mixing rule is on the [packages page](/packages).

Cups arrive in boxes of 24 with no lids, so a 96 comes as four boxes ready to unpack onto your table.

How many to order? See the cups-per-guest guide on [packages](/packages). Feeding more than 96? Order more than one pack: each pack follows the same rules, and there's no maximum order size.

sections.heading: Theme your dessert table with flavour colours
sections.body:
Every flavour has its own colours, which makes it easy to build a table around a theme.

- **Blush and red:** [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields), glossy red compote over blush-pink cream, with cream rosettes on top.
- **Lilac and violet:** [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze), near-black violet compote over lilac cream, finished with fresh blueberries.
- **Sunny yellow and orange:** [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream), a saffron-orange mango layer over pale yellow cream, topped with a cream dollop.
- **Milk chocolate:** [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno), milk-chocolate cream under glossy ganache, with a striped chocolate bite.
- **Dark and glossy:** [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale), dark ganache crowned with a crunchy hazelnut sphere.
- **Caramel and amber:** [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss), caramel-tan cream under an amber top, with a cookie standing upright.
- **Green and gold:** [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate), pale green cream with golden kunafa strands mid-cup, dark ganache and a green marbled swirl.
- **Cocoa:** [Tiramisu](/menu/tiramisu), with a matte cocoa-dusted top. Dessert Cups (5 oz) only.

The event pages put these colours together for weddings, showers and graduations. You'll find the layers, bottom to top, on the [menu](/menu).

sections.heading: Timing: notice, delivery, pickup and storage
sections.body:
- **Notice:** at least 48 hours for a 24 or 48, and at least 7 days for a 96. Under 48 hours, a 24 or 48 counts as urgent: subject to availability, with a rush fee and no guarantee. Shorter notice isn't offered for a 96.
- **Confirmation:** we confirm requests within the day, by email, text or Instagram.
- **Deposit:** a deposit confirms your order. We explain how to pay it when we confirm.
- **Freshness:** cups are made the morning of your pickup or delivery.
- **Delivery:** Saturdays, to Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto. The fee depends on your location and is quoted as part of your total when we confirm. Ask for a delivery time in your notes; someone needs to be there to receive the cups.
- **Pickup:** free in Hamilton, by arrangement. We share the location with the person who ordered once the order is confirmed, and a friend, colleague or courier can collect.
- **On the day:** keep the cups refrigerated until you set out the table. They can sit out for about 2 hours.

Planning a Saturday event with delivery of a 24 or 48? We suggest sending your request by Wednesday, which keeps you well clear of the 48-hour minimum. For a 96, send it by 9 AM on the same day the week before.

Local details are on [dessert cups in Hamilton](/dessert-cups-hamilton) and [Saturday delivery beyond Hamilton](/dessert-cups-gta).

sections.heading: What happens after you send a request
sections.body:
Ordering here is a request, not a checkout, and there's no online payment.

1. Choose your size, pack and flavours on the [order page](/order). The form keeps your mix within the pack rules. Add any notes.
2. We confirm within the day, by email, text or Instagram.
3. We send your total, with the delivery fee for your location if you chose delivery, and explain how to pay the deposit that confirms your order. If you're picking up, we tell you where.
4. Your cups are made the morning of pickup or delivery.

Questions before you start? The [FAQ](/faq) covers allergens, lead time, delivery and flavours per pack.

faqs.q: My event isn't listed. Can I still use these packs?
faqs.a: Yes. Sizes, packs, flavour rules, notice, delivery and pickup work the same for any gathering. Tell us about your event in the notes when you send your request.
